description: Use this when the user asks where to get a campaign's footage: every source link we found in the brief. Public videos and channels (YouTube, Twitch, Kick, TikTok, Instagram, X and more) with platform, title, length, the video details we store (channel, publish date, views, language, speakers, chapters, format and a short summary in our own words) and a link to the video at each top moment. The brand asset links (Google Drive, Dropbox, Frame.io, WeTransfer, OneDrive, Box, Mega) the campaign page shows, named by service. Signed in, also the ones behind a sign-in and the Evangelist library. Also exampleClips, the clipping platform's top clips: other clippers' approved posts (app, post link, handle, the views the platform reports, rank), most viewed first, examples of what gets approved and never footage to cut. Links only, never a file copy or a transcript. Read only.

campaign.description: The campaign as brand/series (for example lovable/clipping), its clippingalpha.com page URL, or its numeric campaignId from another tool.
